title: 530. Optimal Account Balancing

examples.explanation: Net balances are -5 for person 0, +10 for person 1, and -5 for person 2, so two payments (one from each debtor to person 1) settle everything.
Net balances are -4 for person 0, +4 for person 1, and 0 for person 2, so a single payment of 4 from person 0 to person 1 settles everyone.

hints: Only each person's net balance matters: collapse all transfers into one balance per person and drop the zeroes.
